findings.detail: Registry accepts only Root-supplied already verified typed journal objects, immutable identity, independent visibility and genuine birth slots. Runtime births bind original createContext; preparation binds full promoted direct-COMMIT capture. A capsule sourcePin is a reference binding, not independent execution proof. No query/response ID admission or ownership/cleanup authority is created.

Date.parse only parses zero-fraction whole seconds, then BigInt retains every1-6 fractional digit. Calendar/offset round-trip and exact integer microsecond window/TTL arithmetic reject1us changes,7-digit fractions and invalid calendar normalization. Physical forms remain+08/max6; DTO formsZ/max3.

Finite operation/table/column allowlist only. Original prepared temporal values including fields outside runtime catalog remain literal. K identifies actual promoted sourcePlan INSERT by UUID reference and explicit columns, using captured full birth rather than invented params. All non-clock columns are retained for Root's strict comparison; this helper does not validate every non-temporal source-plan scalar.

Rule effective_from may become now only from proven NULL; request effectiveFrom and paidAt remain actual literals. Package exact original single now gives created_at+24h; upload1h/ticket2min and controlled grant2h/24h each subtract into actual independent source windows. Grant TTL must use the same bound real controlled-token proof as AES/state, not arbitrary caller values. Copied attachment uploaded_at must match an already registered owned session source.

Each physical version must contain all actual table columns and exact immutable identity. Literal mutations require exact existing committed journal before/after/values and txid/xmin. Unknown fields/time changes cannot be generalized by At$; failed method poisons further registry use, with rejected=true retained in receipt.

DTO may project only one actually observed full typed physical version with exact same instant. A genuine emitter that truncates PG sub-ms to JSDate ms requires a separate named source rule; missing proof is pending integration, not a product incompatibility conclusion. Nested audit snapshots, org failedAt, grant JSON/DTO, archive manifest and top-level generatedAt are instructions only and not automatically normalized.
